content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for JIPMER Clinical Trial Coordinator Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 10-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JIPMER Clinical Trial Coordinator position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 10-08-2026. Ensure your application reaches the specified email address by 10 PM on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for this role?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a B.Sc. degree in Nursing, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Biotechnology, Clinical Research, or allied health sciences from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any experience required for the Clinical Trial Coordinator post?
faq.answer: Yes, a minimum of one year of experience in clinical research or clinical trial coordination is required for this position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Clinical Trial Coordinator position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years. However, age relaxation of up to 5 years is provided for candidates with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the Clinical Trial Coordinator role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a written test covering various aspects of clinical trials and a subsequent interview to assess communication skills and knowledge.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Clinical Trial Coordinator position?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs 28,000 per patient recruitment and follow-up. No other allowances will be provided.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application procedure for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates need to email their filled application form, CV, and supporting documents to [email protected] before the deadline.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for JIPMER Clinical Trial Coordinator recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: This is a project-based job, indicating it is for a specific research project duration.

faq.question: Q10. Where is JIPMER located?
faq.answer: JIPMER is located in Puducherry, with the specific address being Puducherry, 605006.
